question: Which divine powers are invoked to protect the back of the practitioner?
premises: The giver of all seeds is invoked.
Protection is requested for the back.
The one who causes all subjugation is invoked.
inference: The goddess as giver of all seeds and cause of all subjugation protects the back.
uncertainties: vaśaṅ retained as fused compound member per surface
plain_english: May she who gives all seeds protect the back; may she who causes all subjugation protect it.
